answer: Every applicant locks 20 POA for ten epochs and must finish four different jobs, each judged by three randomly assigned reviewers who never share a funder. Two matching approvals pass a job; proven fakery burns 12% of the bond. Timestamps and signatures stay on chain: a comet of bursts reveals bot swarms, a mesa of steady epochs shows real tenure, and a grove of distinct reviewers proves independent work. Because each sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, mass identity creation stays unprofitable.
